messages.en: What do I do?! I'm already so excited!
I can't believe today's the Seoul concert!
You kind of sound like an Animal Crossing villager.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I heard a rumor that this world's fake... bwee?
Apparently we're all being controlled... bwee.
That's so scary... bwee!
I was doing
an Animal Crossing villager impression.
Let's have lots of fun today.
Let's enjoy it to the fullest~!
I'm so excited.
To all the Hexagon WAVs coming to the concert,
travel safely. It's raining.
And to all the Hexagon WAVs watching online,
don't take your eyes off the screen
and keep your full attention on it!
Okay, I'll only look at you.
Oh? Then do that~
Sorry... I'm going to look at the other members too...

messages.ko: 지나친 솔직함은 하연이의 따가운 눈초리를 불러요
messages.en: Being a little too honest will earn you HaYeon's icy glare.
I kind of hope you just do the 'Sseu-tting' at the concert.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Should I just do it?
Should I just go for it???
Should I just live for today??!!
Nope, we've got tomorrow too...
I couldn't hold back my excitement before the concert,
so I came by.
I couldn't hold back how much I missed you.
See you very soon.
I'll be getting everything ready.
I'll be looking forward to the fluorescent headband and pigtails. 😉
That actually caught me off guard ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Cute.
What if I'm the only one glowing when the venue goes dark?
That'd be pretty charming.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Just come as you are.
You know I can see everyone watching online too, right?
I'm serious.
Watch out for the cameras.
I can see everything from here~
Ah, I guess I'd better stop by the salon first.
If you head over around 4 o'clock now, that should be perfect. ㅇㅇ
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Anyway, see you in a little bit.
Haranghae. 💕😘
